people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Jokshan
people.line: A son of Abraham and Keturah

people.name: Midian
people.line: Son of Abraham and Keturah; father of the Midianites.

people.name: Shuah
people.line: Son of Abraham and Keturah, ancestor of a tribe.

translations.web: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
translations.bsb: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
translations.kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
translations.asv: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
